dc_get_league_of_team.note: int DataController::GetLeagueOfTeam(DC, int team) 0x14154B92C: the team's leagueid from the game's cache (global 0x14C36C220) or SELECT leagueid FROM leagueteamlinks WHERE teamid (exactly one row, else -1); GetPlayerTeam 0x14154C5C4 and the nation lookups 0x147B85A10 use it with IsInternationalLeague

is_international_league.note: bool IsInternationalLeague(int leagueid) 0x14479F50C: leagueid 0x4E (78) / 0x858 (2136) / 0xBBC (3004) or the runtime id at 0x14BE9C9C0: the game's definition of a national team's league (GetPlayerTeam skips them)
